title: Big crude-oil and copper days as a lead for spot gold

rule.signal: |close-to-close return| > 2 x sd of the 60 returns before the day
rule.entry: gold's next folded UTC daily open (first gold day later than the signal day)
rule.exit: close of the 3rd gold candle (entry candle = 1)
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade ($0.3 spread + $0.15 slippage on each of two market orders) + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: big WTI day, gold traded the same way for 3 days (primary)
big WTI day, gold traded the other way for 3 days (fade)
big copper day, gold traded the same way for 3 days

info.what: big Brent day, gold the same way (informational, no test)
